stories.title: Tarik Skubal Is a Los Angeles Dodger

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
OFFICIAL: Tarik Skubal is a Los Angeles Dodger.

The two-time AL Cy Young winner heads to LA in exchange for Zyhir Hope (MLB Pipeline Top 25 overall), River Ryan, and Brady Smith.

The biggest trade of the deadline is done. #Dodgers #Tigers

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The Tigers' return for Skubal: Zyhir Hope (MLB Pipeline Top 25), River Ryan, and Brady Smith.

Detroit gets elite prospect value. LA gets ace insurance with Ohtani's return uncertain.

#Dodgers #Tigers

24 hours until the MLB Trade Deadline closes (6 PM ET, Aug. 3).

Done: Skubal to LAD, Castillo to CWS, Kremer + Minter to MIN, Doval to PIT, Naylor to MIL, O'Hoppe to TEX.

Still moving: Kirby, Rutschman, Peralta.

x_posts.text:
George Kirby went from untouchable to available as Seattle fell out of Wild Card contention.

Adley Rutschman is on the table in Baltimore. Freddy Peralta could be next.

The deadline closes tomorrow at 6 PM ET.

stories.title: Dylan Cease Stays in Toronto — And Now He's the AL Cy Young Frontrunner

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
With Skubal heading to LA, Dylan Cease is now the AL Cy Young frontrunner.

His case: 7-5, 2.46 ERA, 167 K in 113.1 IP. July ERA: 1.00.

Blue Jays aren't moving him. #BlueJays

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
Dylan Cease's July ERA: 1.00 — fourth-lowest single-month mark in Blue Jays history (min. 30 IP).

He also threw a 1-hit CG vs Boston, striking out 12.

First Blue Jays 1-hit CG in 16 years. #BlueJays

stories.title: Shohei Ohtani's Pitching Return Is Still Weeks Away

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
Shohei Ohtani threw a 31-pitch bullpen session — but Dave Roberts says it'll be at least a week to 10 days before he pitches in a game.

No start on this road trip. Left knee and right biceps remain issues. #Dodgers

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
The Dodgers' Skubal acquisition makes much more sense with this context:

Ohtani hasn't pitched in a game since July 3, and there's no guarantee he's back before October. #Dodgers

stories.title: Chris Sale at 37 — The Most Underrated Story of the Season

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Chris Sale at 37: 12-6, 2.08 ERA, 143 K, 1.02 WHIP in 117 IP.

Third-lowest ERA by any pitcher 37 or older since 1950 — behind only Clemens (2005) and Verlander (2022).

The most underrated story of the season. #Braves
